baseline_models.focus_anchor: يُرِيدُ ... لِيَفْجُرَ أَمَامَهُ links deliberate willing, breach of restraint, and the field in front.
baseline_models.mechanism: Will supplies the motive, فجور supplies a boundary-breaking act, and أمامه projects that act through the space or time ahead. The focus therefore depicts an intended continuing trajectory, not a single accidental lapse.

activation_trace.role: Will and intention make the breach a chosen project rather than an involuntary event.
Departure from right and breach of restraint identify the intended action as transgressive boundary-crossing.
Frontward position supplies the open field across which the intended breach is projected.

changed_reading.before: The human wants to commit wrongdoing in the future.
changed_reading.after: The human deliberately wants the whole forward field kept available for continuing breaches of restraint.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The branch interaction of يُرِيدُ, يَفْجُرَ, and أَمَامَهُ permits a spatial mechanism of seeking, opening, and heading.
baseline_models.mechanism: Seeking scouts what lies ahead, wide splitting opens a passage, and aiming gives that passage a direction. The line can image desire as advance work that cuts a usable corridor through future constraint.

activation_trace.role: Seeking and scouting supplies exploratory advance toward a desired opening.
Wide splitting and outflow turn the act into opening a passage through what contains it.
Aiming and heading toward gives the opened passage a chosen forward direction.

changed_reading.before: The human merely wishes to sin later.
changed_reading.after: Desire scouts the future and tries to split open a directed corridor through its restraints.

context_deltas.mechanism: The forward field becomes an accountable ledger: the human will receive news of what he advanced and what he delayed. Thus the desired license ahead continually produces items that are sent forward or left behind for disclosure.

activation_trace.role: Deliberate intention supplies the accountable motive behind the forward conduct.
Breach of restraint supplies the conduct that enters the later account.
Frontward position is the focus anchor recoded as accountable temporal advance.
A delivered report makes the consequences of the forward course explicitly return as news.
Advancing forward gives the ledger a direct spatial-temporal counterpart to أمامه.
Delay to a later time supplies the complementary category of what was postponed.

structural_cues: The paired verbs قَدَّمَ وَأَخَّرَ in 75:13 answer the directional أَمَامَهُ of 75:5 with an explicit before-and-after accounting axis.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies intention, forwardness, breach, later report, advance, and delay; I infer that acts done 'ahead' populate the report. A live alternative is that 75:13 inventories deeds without specifically redefining أمامه.

changed_reading.before: Ahead is an apparently blank span in which the human hopes to transgress.
changed_reading.after: Ahead is already an accounting axis: each intended breach becomes something advanced or delayed and later reported back to the human.

context_deltas.mechanism: The apparently self-cleared corridor ahead closes into an imposed route. Escape is sought, refuge is denied, the endpoint is fixed with the Lord, and the traveler is finally driven there.

activation_trace.role: Wide splitting supplies the attempted opening of a forward escape corridor.
Frontward position anchors the route whose apparent openness is reversed.
Flight and escape expose what the desired open route was expected to provide.
The refuge image, explicitly negated in sequence, removes any protective destination along that route.
Lordship and sovereignty identify who controls the route's endpoint.
Fixity and settlement close the fantasy of indefinite forward openness.
Driving and herding reverse self-directed advance into compelled movement to the fixed end.

structural_cues: 75:10-12 moves from 'where is escape?' to 'no refuge' to a fixed destination, while 75:30 repeats 'to your Lord' as the destination of the driving.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a forward opening, escape, denied refuge, fixed settlement, sovereignty, and driving; I supply the arrow that these cues close the corridor imagined in 75:5. They could alternatively be successive consequences without spatially revising the focus.

changed_reading.before: The human imagines that breaching restraint can keep the road ahead open on his own terms.
changed_reading.after: The road ahead is not open-ended: it has no side refuge, belongs to the Lord, and ends in a compelled arrival.

context_deltas.mechanism: The desire is enclosed by an inner audit. The self carries reason, repeatedly blames, possesses inward sight against itself, and can only cast excuses; the forward breach is therefore knowingly preauthorized rather than performed in simple ignorance.

activation_trace.role: Will and intention locate the action inside deliberate motive.
Breach of right supplies the conduct scrutinized by the inner audit.
Reason and awareness within the self supply an interior site of judgment.
Blame for what merits censure makes the interior judgment morally specific.
Insight of the heart turns the human into a witness against his own motive.
Excuse and exculpation supply the defensive speech that cannot erase self-knowledge.

structural_cues: Corrective بَلْ in 75:5 and بَلِ in 75:14 repeatedly move past an outward claim toward motive and self-witness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies deliberate will, blame, inward insight, and excuses; I infer that the insight is live during or around the intention, making the breach knowing. A live alternative is that blame and insight arise only after the conduct.

changed_reading.before: The line diagnoses appetite for future wrongdoing.
changed_reading.after: The line diagnoses a knowing attempt to authorize future breaches despite an already functioning inner witness.

context_deltas.mechanism: A second kind of forward pressure appears in 75:16-19: premature tongue-motion and haste are checked by an ordered sequence of gathering, recitation, following, and explanation. Against that sequence, the focus can describe the broader impulse to get ahead of order and force-open what should be received in stages.

activation_trace.role: Seeking and scouting supplies anticipatory movement into what has not yet arrived.
Wide splitting supplies the image of forcing material open ahead of its ordered disclosure.
Aiming and heading forward anchor the anticipatory direction of the impulse.
Movement against stillness supplies the premature bodily push that is checked.
Hurrying and bringing forward name the temporal error of getting ahead.
Gathering dispersed parts begins the alternative ordered process.
Reading and recitation supply the received event that must occur before response.
Following behind reverses the urge to lead or outrun the sequence.
Disclosure of meaning completes the sequence after gathering and following.

structural_cues: The imperatives and assurances in 75:16-19 order the verbs as wait, gathering/recitation, following, then explanation; that choreography opposes premature forward motion.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies forced forward motion in the focus and an explicit haste-versus-sequence contrast in 75:16-19; I infer a shared disposition of preemption. The materially live alternative is that 75:16-19 is a distinct address whose sequencing should not modify the moral sense of 75:5.

changed_reading.before: The breach is only moral license extended into the future.
changed_reading.after: The breach also activates as preemption: an urge to get ahead of ordered disclosure and force open what should be followed rather than led.

context_deltas.mechanism: Love fixes the will on what can be brought forward now, while the later is actively left. This present-bias explains why the human wants to keep breaking the forward boundary: immediate desire repeatedly consumes the future and discards its claim.

activation_trace.role: Will and inward inclination provide the motivational link to what is loved.
Breach of restraint is the mechanism by which immediate desire overrides the later claim.
The frontward field is the temporal horizon repeatedly subordinated to the immediate.
Hurrying and bringing forward supply the temporal character of the immediate.
Love lodged in the heart turns temporal preference into a durable motive.
Leaving something behind makes neglect of the later active rather than accidental.
Laterness supplies the horizon sacrificed to immediate attachment.

structural_cues: The corrective كَلَّا بَلْ of 75:20 resumes the motive-revealing بَلْ of 75:5, then states the immediate/later opposition in two balanced clauses.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies will, immediate love, and abandonment of the later; I infer a causal arrow from present attachment to repeated future breach. An alternative is that 75:20-21 diagnoses the audience generally rather than the singular human of 75:5.

changed_reading.before: The human wants an indefinite future in which to do wrong.
changed_reading.after: The human keeps breaching the future because love of what can be brought forward now actively displaces what comes later.

context_deltas.mechanism: The future ceases to be empty extension and becomes an encounter registered on faces. One face directs perception toward the Lord; another contracts while anticipating a back-breaking event. What lies 'in front' is therefore something the human will have to face and that will expose his orientation.

activation_trace.role: Frontward position anchors the future as an eventual face-to-face encounter.
The intended breach supplies the conduct whose future encounter is borne on the face.
The branch's joined image of face and future directly bridges bodily countenance and what confronts a person.
Directed sight or insight gives the favorable face an intentional orientation toward its Lord.
Facial contraction and intense aversion make the adverse encounter visibly embodied.
Certainty formed from signs turns the feared future from vague possibility into recognized approach.
A back-breaking calamity supplies the concrete event that the adverse face expects.

structural_cues: 75:22-25 alternates two face states, then assigns each an orientation or expectation; this makes future consequence perceptible before it arrives.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies frontwardness, the face/future branch, directed sight, aversion, expectation, and calamity; I infer that 'ahead' becomes what must be faced. Alternatively, the face scenes may portray outcomes without feeding back into the semantics of أمامه.

changed_reading.before: Ahead is duration available for transgression.
changed_reading.after: Ahead is an unavoidable encounter that will take form on the human face and reveal what it is oriented toward.

context_deltas.mechanism: The human who imagines voluntary forward extension reaches a bodily limit: life reaches its terminus, separation is recognized, limbs wind together, and movement becomes a driving. The future corridor is converted into an involuntary passage through death.

activation_trace.role: Splitting and outflow supply the imagined self-made passage and echo the later separation.
Frontward position anchors the path whose mode of travel changes.
Arrival at a limit gives the forward span a bodily terminus.
Splitting and a separated part turn the focus's chosen breach into recognized mortal separation.
One thing winding over another constricts the body that had imagined free advance.
Driving and herding replace autonomous motion with compelled passage.

structural_cues: The tightly ordered إذا/و/و/إلى sequence in 75:26-30 narrows from bodily threshold to separation, entangled legs, and destination.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies forwardness, reaching a limit, separation, winding, and driving; I infer a reversal from chosen extension to involuntary passage. A live alternative is that the death sequence limits the desire without changing its spatial mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The human treats the future as a route he can keep extending by force.
changed_reading.after: His forward route narrows into the body's terminal passage, where reaching, separation, entanglement, and driving remove his control.

context_deltas.mechanism: The latent desire becomes a visible behavioral chain: failure to realize truth in deed and worship, active denial, turning away, then walking back to the familiar social circle with an extended swagger. The forward breach is enacted as doctrine, refusal, direction, gait, and audience.

activation_trace.role: Intention supplies the latent program that the later actions enact.
Departure from right names the shared function of the enacted sequence.
Frontwardness becomes an actual direction of movement rather than only imagined time.
Realizing truth in deed, here negated, marks the first failed restraint.
The specific act of worship, also negated, gives the breach a ritual expression.
Attributing the message to falsehood supplies active doctrinal rejection.
Turning away converts rejection into bodily direction.
Going onward realizes the focus's forward vector as actual movement.
The circle of kin and belonging supplies the social destination before which the posture is displayed.
Swagger through extended bearing makes the inward license publicly embodied.

structural_cues: 75:31-33 advances from two negations through لَٰكِنْ into denial, turning, going, social return, and swagger, producing a complete action chain.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a stated motive and a later chain of refusal and movement; I infer that the chain manifests that motive. A live alternative is that the later singular figure is exemplary but not necessarily identical with the الإنسان of 75:5.

changed_reading.before: The focus names an inward wish for future license.
changed_reading.after: The wish is a behavioral program enacted in denial, ritual refusal, turning away, forward gait, and swagger before one's own people.

context_deltas.mechanism: The fantasy of an ungoverned future is answered by the human's own governed history. He was not released without direction: measured generative material became an attached stage, was proportioned, completed, and made into paired forms; the same power can restore life after loss of power.

activation_trace.role: Human intention supplies the claim to direct the future on personal terms.
Aiming and heading supply the focus's self-directed trajectory.
Release and letting go, denied by the rhetorical question, names the autonomy the human presumes.
Measuring and carrying a determination through supplies authorship at the trajectory's generative beginning.
A pregnancy fixed in the womb supplies a dependent, attached developmental stage.
Proportioning and measuring supply deliberate formation rather than random self-extension.
Intrinsic straightness and completion mark the formed stage as brought to wholeness.
Causing a thing to become a state supplies the transition into differentiated paired forms.
Effective capacity to perform and rule supplies the agentive power governing both origins and end.
Living ensouled being supplies the state that can be restored.
Loss of power and life supplies the apparent terminal state over which restoration is asserted.

structural_cues: 75:36-40 forms a backward-to-forward proof: not left aimless, origin as fluid, attached stage, creation and completion, paired differentiation, then capacity to revive.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies presumed release, measured development, formed transitions, effective capacity, death, and life; I infer temporal symmetry between an authored past and a governed future. The alternative is that the closing sequence proves resurrection while leaving the psychology of أمامه untouched.

changed_reading.before: The human's will appears able to author an unbounded trajectory ahead.
changed_reading.after: That autonomy is weakened by his own measured trajectory: the one who authored his prior transformations also governs the future beyond death.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant ر و د to ر د د mapping and a secondary tarrying image under ل و م, so it must not be rendered as the direct lexical gloss of يُرِيدُ or لَوَّامَة. It remains anchored in the mapped focus root, the focus breach, and the context's blaming self; downstream prose should mark it as an exploratory cyclic psychology.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus will is read through the packet-authorized return/wavering branch while يَفْجُرَ remains the repeated breach around which the cycle turns.

activation_trace.role: Repetition and wavering recast intention as a will that circles back rather than advancing once.
Breach of restraint supplies the recurrent act around which the wavering turns.
Tarrying before action inserts hesitation into the breach cycle rather than canceling it.
The self's inner reason supplies the chamber in which wavering and renewed resolve recur.

changed_reading.before: The verse depicts a settled linear intention followed by future transgression.
changed_reading.after: It may also expose a loop of hesitation, breach, blame, and returned intention that repeatedly projects itself ahead.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain optical reading is surprising because it activates dawn-breaking and perception branches rather than the ordinary moral branch of فجور. It remains anchored in the focus's perception-capable human, breaking, and frontward field, then receives an exact contextual reversal in stunned sight and sinking light. Downstream prose should present it only as an image-level activation, not as a replacement translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: إِنسَان, يَفْجُرَ, and أَمَامَهُ can combine as a perceiver trying to break open what is hidden in front.

activation_trace.role: Perceiving by sight, sense, or hearing makes the human an agent seeking awareness of what lies ahead.
Dawn breaking from night supplies an image of forcing hidden futurity into visibility.
The frontward field locates the obscurity the perceiver tries to open.
The fixed, staring eye reverses active visual mastery into stunned exposure.
Literal eyesight identifies the faculty whose attempted command of the future fails.
The sinking-eye image transfers withdrawal and occlusion to the moon, countering the focus's dawn-opening image.

changed_reading.before: The human wants freedom to violate limits in the future.
changed_reading.after: At image level, the human may also want to tear open and see the hidden future, only for the context to answer with stunned vision and withdrawn light.

strongest_changes: The advanced/deferred ledger of 75:13 turns أَمَامَهُ from blank future into accountable temporal placement.
Escape, denied refuge, fixed settlement, and driving close the self-cleared corridor into an imposed route to the Lord.
Love of the immediate and active abandonment of the later identify present-bias as the engine of continuing breach.
The refusal-and-swagger sequence enacts the inward desire, while the measured creation sequence weakens its claim to autonomous forward control.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet exposed repeated directional mechanisms around the one focus construction: forward/back accounting, self-direction versus following, voluntary advance versus driving, visible posture, and an authored developmental trajectory. Keeping these mechanisms separate preserved changes that a single thematic paraphrase would collapse.
remaining_uncertainties: أَمَامَهُ can sustain temporal, spatial, and encounter-oriented readings, but the packet does not force one of them to exclude the others.
The ordered-reception contrast in 75:16-19 is structurally strong but may be a distinct address rather than a direct revision of 75:5.
The breach-blame loop and forced-visibility reading depend on form-distant or cross-domain branches and should remain explicitly exploratory.
